description: This source file implements functions for interfacing with WebPA and Parodus, managing component health checks, Ethernet WAN status, and device MAC retrieval in a network management context.

methods.name: Cosa_FindDestComp
methods.description: Finds the destination component and path supporting a given object name namespace.

methods.name: sendWebpaMsg
methods.description: Constructs and sends a WebPA message via Parodus with retry logic.

methods.name: initparodusTask
methods.description: Creates a thread to handle Parodus initialization and connection management.

methods.name: handle_parodus
methods.description: Thread function that initializes and manages Parodus connection with exponential backoff retries.

methods.name: rdk_logger_module_fetch
methods.description: Returns the module name for logging purposes.

methods.name: waitForEthAgentComponentReady
methods.description: Waits until the Ethernet agent component reports healthy status.

methods.name: checkComponentHealthStatus
methods.description: Checks the health status of a specified component via CCSP.

methods.name: check_ethernet_wan_status
methods.description: Determines if Ethernet WAN is enabled and operational.

methods.name: getDeviceMac
methods.description: Retrieves the device MAC address, either from sysevent or via component parameter queries.
